remarks: An amazing opportunity to own right by Old Towne Orange! This one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo offers a bright, open layout and a prime location within a small, gated community where homes rarely become available. Overlooking a lush, peaceful courtyard and featuring a private patio, this condo is move-in ready. Inside, the welcoming living area includes a versatile space perfect for a work-from-home setup or reading nook. The kitchen features granite countertops and ample storage, flowing seamlessly into the dining area.
